host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Citadel server to connect to.

port.description: TCP port on which the Citadel server listens (standard: 504).

datadir.description: Path to Citadel's data directory (contains user databases, cache, etc.).

configdir.description: Path to Citadel's configuration directory (e.g., containing modules, startup scripts).

logfile.description: Path to the client log file. Use '-' to log to stderr.

verbose.description: Enable verbose debug logging (includes protocol traces and internal state).

ssl_enabled.description: Enable encrypted communication with the Citadel server via TLS.

ssl_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for server certificate validation (only if SSL enabled).

ssl_client_cert.description: Path to client certificate for mutual TLS (leave blank to disable).

ssl_client_key.description: Path to client private key for mutual TLS (must accompany client_cert).

default_domain.description: Default domain suffix to append to usernames that lack one (e.g., 'user' becomes 'user@example.com').

allow_anonymous.description: Permit login without credentials (typically only for public rooms or testing).

auth_backends.description: Ordered list of authentication backends to try (e.g., local, ldap, radius, pam).

name.description: Name of the backend (must match an entry in auth_backends).

options.description: Key-value configuration for this backend (structure depends on backend type).

auth_backend_options.description: Per-backend tuning parameters (e.g., LDAP bind DN, server URIs, timeouts).

connect_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a TCP connection to complete.

read_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a response from the server after sending a command.

max_retries.description: Number of times to retry failed operations due to transient errors (e.g., timeouts).

auto_reconnect.description: Automatically reconnect if the server closes the connection unexpectedly.

default_charset.description: Default character encoding for text content (e.g., UTF-8, ISO-8859-1).

compression_enabled.description: Enable payload compression (if both client and server support it).

items.description: CIDR notation of trusted subnets (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24'). Bypass authentication if enabled server-side.

trusted_subnets.description: List of network ranges where clients may connect without authentication.

items.description: Exact hostname to accept as valid regardless of certificate chain (dangerous; for testing only).

trusted_hosts.description: Hostnames whose TLS certificates are trusted even if unverifiable.
